title: Go III Professional: Taikyoku Igo
overview:
Even stronger, more comfortable: the new-style go software gets its long-awaited power-up!

- 12 strength levels to match your skill
- Choose a 9x9 or 13x13 board in addition to the 19x19 board
- Handicap games with 2 to 9 stones and free position setup
- Game record saving and playback

- Varied graphics - 6 types of stones, 6 boards, 9 backgrounds, 2D/3D switching and more
- Elegant classical masterpieces as BGM (7 pieces including Bach and Brahms)

さらに「強く」より「快適」に
新感覚の対局囲碁ソフトが待望のパワーアップ！

●棋力に合わせて12段階の強さ選択
●19路盤の他に9路盤・13路盤も選択可能
●2～9子の置碁設定、自由局面設定が可能
●棋譜保存・再生機能

■多彩なグラフィック――碁石6種類・盤6種類・背景9種類　2D/3D切替等
■格調高いクラシック名曲がBGM（バッハ・ブラームスなど7種類）
